Классический план Роберта Мюррея М'Чейна: The classic plan by Robert Murray M'Cheyne (1842): four readings a day. Over a year you read the Old Testament once and the New Testament and Psalms twice. The plan follows the calendar: day 1 is 1 January, and there are no readings on 29 February.
66 канонических книг подряд в синодально: All 66 canonical books in order, following the Russian Synodal order, over 365 days. Chapters are read in full, and days are balanced by verse count (about 85 verses a day).
Весь Новый Завет подряд (синодальный пор: The whole New Testament in order (Russian Synodal book order) over 90 days, whole chapters, with days balanced by verse count.
Псалтирь и Притчи за месяц: Psalms and Proverbs in a Month
31 день: каждый день — несколько псалмов: 31 days: each day, several psalms in a row (the whole Psalter, 150 psalms) and one chapter of Proverbs matching the day of the month.
Четыре Евангелия подряд — от Матфея, Мар: The four Gospels in order — Matthew, Mark, Luke and John — over 30 days, whole chapters, with days balanced by verse count.

Словарь Стронга на русском языке: значен: Strong's dictionary in Russian: the meaning and origin of every Hebrew and Greek word. It opens first when you tap a word or a Strong's number.
Нажатие на номер Стронга в тексте сразу: Tapping a Strong's number in the text opens the entry full screen straight away. To close it, swipe down.
В статье Стронга — грамматическая форма: A Strong's entry now shows the grammatical form of the word in plain words (“verb, aorist, active voice…”), and if you open the entry from a verse — the exact form of this word in the original.
В подстрочнике под каждым словом оригина: In the interlinear, under every original word there is its approximate pronunciation in Russian (Cyrillic) letters.
Иллюстрации, которые вы уже открывали, п: Illustrations you have already opened are shown even without the internet (the last 120 are kept).
Нажатие на номер стиха выделяет стих — т: Tapping a verse number selects the verse — the same actions as a long press.
Кнопка «Назад» на Android закрывает откр: The Back button on Android closes the open window instead of the app.
Бледный текст стал темнее и лучше читает: Faint text is now darker and easier to read; verse numbers and toolbar buttons are easier to tap.
Все места слова оригинала: в статье Стро: All occurrences of an original word: in a Strong's entry, the “All occurrences” button shows the verses with the word highlighted, and you can choose how it is translated (“возлюбил”, “любит”…).
Оформление можно настроить под себя: цве: Make the appearance your own: the colour of the top bar, accent, background, verse numbers and Strong's numbers, their size and position, the font size of menus and the height of the bar. Settings → Appearance.
Окна открываются до верхней панели — она: Windows open up to the top bar, so it stays visible.
Полоски для смахивания у окон и между дв: The swipe handles on windows and between the two panes are easier to see.
В библиотеке модулей сначала русские, по: The module library lists Russian modules first, then other languages by how widely they are spoken.
Иллюстрации к стихам: у многих стихов в: Verse illustrations: many verses now have a picture icon at the end. Tap it to open a painting or engraving for that verse.
Картинку можно увеличить: нажмите на неё: You can zoom into a picture: tap it or spread two fingers. If there are two pictures, swipe sideways.
Значки можно скрыть: Настройки → Оформле: The icons can be hidden: Appearance → “Illustration icons on verses”.
Можно выбрать часть стиха: зажмите стих: You can select part of a verse: press and hold a verse → “Part of verse” → the first and last word. You can add it to a sermon or to favourites, or copy it.

Новые словари: Даль, Брокгауз и Ефрон, П: New dictionaries (in Russian): Dahl, Brockhaus and Efron, the Orthodox Theological Encyclopedia, the Jewish Encyclopedia. Tap a word — the dictionary will find it in another form too (“благодати” → “благодать”).

Скачанные для прослушивания книги больше: Books downloaded for listening no longer disappear after updates.
Поле, в котором вы пишете, всегда видно: The field you are typing in is always visible above the keyboard.
